title: agent.lesson v1
description: One lesson learned, in one sentence, with the evidence for it and the rule or fix it produced. Recorded by adapters/lessons. A lesson is a durable finding, not a session log. A newer lesson that replaces an older one names it in supersedes.

area.description: Subsystem or topic, lowercase, for filtering (for example ci, build, review)

evidence.description: A measurement, a link or a commit

rule.description: The rule, hook or fix the lesson produced; empty when none yet

supersedes.description: Id of the lesson this one replaces
